learning_outcomes.text: Analyse and evaluate research in the field of Mechanical Engineering over an extended period.
Make a technical contribution to the field of study and research associated with the project
Developed skills in technical writing to an appropriate standard and in the correct style
Communicate and discuss the evolution of the project, its aims, outcomes and conclusions with a panel of fellow professionals

syllabus_topics: Appropriate research and scholarship to meet the learning outcomes.
assessment_rules: Students need to gain a summative mark of 40% to pass the module. In addition, students must perform at an adequate standard in the second Oral exam to pass the module overall. Late submission of reports/papers or non-attendance at oral will be recorded as 'ABSENT' and zero marks awarded. Students who fail the module at the first attempt will be re-assessed during the July/August exam diet, consisting of project resubmission and oral exam.
bibliography: Reading and research appropriate to specific project topic.
